verdict.rationale: Together AI ships an official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK on GitHub with SSE streaming support. Its docs reference launching jobs "through the API/SDK" and offer agent skills that teach "SDK patterns". A community user confirms a Python API, and OpenAI SDK compatibility needs only an API key and base URL change. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Python SDK and the full language coverage, in-depth SDK reference docs in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
